headline: Trump-Vance public split on Netanyahu endorsement ahead of Oct 27 Israeli election
dek: Trump endorsed Netanyahu Monday ('great warrior prime minister'). Vance, in a 2WAY interview, DECLINED to endorse: 'I endorse American candidates...
sources: Trump (Monday); JD Vance (2WAY interview); Netanyahu (Tuesday video)
fault_line: The president endorses a foreign PM one week before an election; his VP publicly refuses to. Coordination or a crack at the top of the ticket?

sections.what_happened: Trump endorsed Netanyahu Monday ('great warrior prime minister'). Vance, in a 2WAY interview, DECLINED to endorse: 'I endorse American candidates... I'm not getting involved in Israeli elections.' Netanyahu released a Tuesday video: 'Donald, we have a job to finish. You said it, and we'll finish it together.' Israeli election Oct 27.
sections.what_verified: The National (Netanyahu video), 2WAY interview transcript relay.
sections.what_disputed: Vance's line is standard non-interference posture; it is a split in optics, not necessarily policy.
sections.why_matters: One ticket, two answers: Trump calls Netanyahu a 'great warrior prime minister' days before Israel votes; Vance says he won't get involved. Netanyahu's reply — 'Donald, we have a job to finish' — names the war, not the election. Watch what the endorsement costs at home.
